'''Fragmentation grenades''', also known as '''frag grenades''', were cheap and low-damage [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] which were used mainly by [[Soldier/Legends|military personnel]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], adventurers, and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

==Description==
Frag grenades consisted of explosive [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] wrapped in a chrome shell.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> They could be set to detonate on impact or set with a timer that lasted several seconds before detonating.<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" /> Frag granades unleashed metal shrapnel and dealt slashing damage. This made them highly effective against unarmored targets. The typical blast radius was about 3 to 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> These items were highly restricted despite their common use. Because of their small size and weight, about 0.5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], detection of these weapons could be difficult.

The frag grenade was similar to the [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], although it was far less powerful. The low cost of frag grenades made them available in large numbers for soldiers. For comparison, a thermal detonator cost between 2,000 and 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credits]]; the frag grenade cost between 50 and 200 credits.

Frag grenades were usually thrown, however they could be loaded into a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] for a far greater range. Grenade launchers themselves could be mounted on vehicles to create an effective anti-infantry weapon.

The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[C-22 fragmentation grenade]] was a typical example of a frag grenade, although the C-22 had a longer timer of up to two minutes.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Fragmentation_Grenade.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout troopers]] using fragmentation grenades.]]Frag grenades were carried as standard armament by many types of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] throughout the ages, as well as [[Planetary Security Forces]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" />

During the [[Old Republic era]], they were used by [[Republic trooper]]s, [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith troopers]], and various [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Rise of the Empire era]] and subsequent [[Rebellion era]], frag grenades were carried by various [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]],<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> as well as most types of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]],<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]],<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> [[Radiation zone assault trooper|Radtroopers]],<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce soldiers]],<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce Assault troopers]],<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]],<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> and by those serving as the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook" /> The agents of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] criminal organization, known as [[Defiler]]s, also carried frag grenades.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />

[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] soldiers used the [[C-16 fragmentation grenade]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /> During the [[Legacy era]], frag grenades were carried by [[Joker Squad]] Stormtroopers.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Individuals who used frag grenades included [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] bounty hunter.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" /> Vehicles were occasionally equipped with grenade launchers that fired frag grenades, such as the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]]<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> and the [[All Terrain Kashyyyk Transport|AT-KT]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frag grenades in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' were beige in color and were a more basic type of grenades. They dealt piercing damage and were moderately effective.<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The damage they did wasn't great, but the player could use them without concern of running out, due to how common they were in the game.
